comment: Ready-made approved-site lists for accounts in Whitelist only mode. A family switches one on instead of typing thirty domains, and can switch on more than one. Each bundle names the sites AND the hosts those sites load from, because a site whose fonts, scripts or attachments are blocked looks broken rather than blocked. Domains include their subdomains. Anything a family adds itself goes on the account's own list, which is merged with these.

shared.label: Fonts and scripts
shared.description: Hosts that almost every site loads its fonts, scripts and stylesheets from. Included automatically whenever any bundle is on; without them ordinary pages render as unstyled text.

bundles.label: Torah study
bundles.description: The big Torah libraries and shiur sites: Sefaria, YUTorah, TorahAnytime, the Daf Yomi sites, Chabad.org, HebrewBooks, OU Torah, Alhatorah and Mechon Mamre, with the hosts their audio and page assets come from.

bundles.label: Email and files
bundles.description: Gmail, Outlook, OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, Proton and iCloud, with the sign-in and content hosts each needs. Deliberately NOT google.com or microsoft.com as a whole: only the mail, drive and sign-in hosts, so this does not open search or video.
